user_request: Configure MCP so execution does not depend on a transient website session.
scope: Only the existing native market audiovisual blocker; no media request, new infrastructure, paid plan or permanent provider adoption.

provider_primary_documentation.observed: RapidAPI documents generated MCP tools hosted on mcp.rapidapi.com, using the selected application's x-rapidapi-key and existing API subscription. Generated configuration is shown inside the authenticated playground.
provider_primary_documentation.not_proven: Exact MCP URL/transport/routing for this API, current active owner subscription, compatible OAuth support and actual media access.

official_openai_documentation.observed: Custom MCP connection supports OAuth, no authentication or mixed OAuth/no authentication.

Portable manifest may declare API-key custom-header auth, but docs distinguish that declaration from portal connection-form support; a manifest file alone does not install/authenticate a ChatGPT connector.

pending_steps: Restore the existing owner's login once in the same cloud tab, without creating an account or repeating Basic Subscribe.
Inspect current Basic entitlement and remaining unit/request/bandwidth balances; obtain only non-secret MCP URL/transport/routing fields from the provider's generated panel.
Use a supported secure credential path for that exact MCP; do not declare API-key protection absent. Stop and report any compatibility gap rather than inventing an endpoint or exposing the key.
Verify an authenticated non-media connection check before the existing single bounded 0–40 second test; preserve any started job before resumption.
Only actual received native video/audio plus measured quality, cost and recurring load can qualify the AV stage.
